overview: Based on the published agenda, the Mosinee School Board's Instructional Programs Committee was scheduled to meet to review and consider recommendations regarding high school crew programming, alongside updates on English language arts material review and mathematics adoption processes.

agenda.item: Approval of Minutes from October 27, 2026 Regular Instructional Programs Meeting
Discussion and Possible Recommendation: HS Crew Presentation
Future Agenda Items - New Course Approval
Future Agenda Items - High School Course and Career Guide

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and consider a possible recommendation regarding a high school crew program presentation. This item was set for formal consideration with a potential recommendation to follow.
The committee was set to receive an update on the English language arts material review process. This was expected to provide status information on the ongoing evaluation of instructional materials.
The committee was scheduled to receive an update on the mathematics adoption process. This item was set to inform the committee of progress on selecting and implementing new math curricula.
